binding_id.description: Immutable unique identifier for this binding.

capital_pool_id.description: The capital pool being bound to.

role.description: The role this persona plays within the pool.

allowed_deployment_scope.description: Upper bound on the deployment stage this binding authorises. Not the current deployment state.

mandate.description: Human-readable mandate or objective for this binding.

budget.description: Capital budget in pool currency units allocated under this binding.

effective_from.description: Inclusive start of the binding validity window.

effective_to.description: Exclusive end of the binding validity window. Null means open-ended.

approval_decision_id.description: ApprovalDecision that authorised this binding (required before activation).
